sloka: ताभिः सहोत्थितं शीघ्रं विमानं प्रेक्ष्य राघवः ।ऋश्यमूकसमीपे तु वैदेहीं पुनरब्रवीत् ।। ६.१२६.३३ ।।
transliteration: tābhiḥ sahotthitaṁ śīghraṁ vimānaṁ prekṣya rāghavaḥ ।ṛśyamūkasamīpe tu vaidehīṁ punarabravīt ।। 6.126.33 ।।

translations.english: "Dear, you have been duly permitted by the great soul Raghava to go to Ayodhya with Vanaras and also women to gratify Mythili."
